faq.q: Do you build new pools and renovate old ones?
faq.a: Both. New builds and renovations are the two core services, alongside spas, water features, infinity edges and underwater windows.

faq.q: Does an old pool need to be replaced, or can it be renovated?
faq.a: An outdated pool doesn't need to be replaced to be transformed. With the right renovation, it can be reimagined into a modern, functional space that feels brand new — new interiors, coping, waterline tiles and reshaping.

faq.q: What interior finishes do you offer?
faq.a: Two options: fully tiled, for lasting durability and a refined, high-end look that resists fading and chemicals; or designer beadcrete with waterline tiles, for a balance of durability, low maintenance and modern style.

faq.q: What happens once we sign on?
faq.a: Four stages: a site inspection and design proposal, then approvals and planning (contracts, permits, engineering, scheduling), then construction — excavation, shell, plumbing, waterproofing, tiling and equipment — and finally filling, handover and a maintenance walkthrough.

faq.q: Who will I actually be dealing with?
faq.a: David and Dianne Moore, and David's son Michael. It's a family-owned business, and reviewers consistently name the three of them individually rather than just "the company."
